summary: Iteration 22 — Full production-readiness verification of AZURIS Gemological (public routes, verification, auth, admin nav, CRUD, certificate issuance + public roundtrip, warranty, ownership assign+transfer+complete, membership, CMS, analytics, envelope). Backend pytest 23/23 PASS. Frontend Playwright: all 11 admin routes load in AdminLayout (dashboard, legalitas, certificates, customers, gemstones, jewelry, warranties, ownership, membership, visuals, settings), home renders (title 'Azuris Gemological — Certification & Verification'), language switcher (data-testid='language-option-en/id') toggles copy, invalid login rejected on /login, valid login lands on /admin/*, all admin-nav-* testids present (none missing), logout redirects to /login, protected /admin/dashboard while unauthed redirects to /login, membership portal /membership?t=bogus shows invalid gracefully, certificate demo preview button [data-testid=cert-demo-preview-btn] opens modal 'Contoh Sertifikat (Pratinjau Demo)' with inline PDF. Backend end-to-end round-trip: created customer + gemstone + issued certificate (format AZR-GEM-000015-26 verified, security code returned once, PDF downloads as %PDF), public POST /api/verify with number+code returns status='valid'; warranty active with derived end_date=start+12 months; ownership assign + transfer + complete correctly updates current_owner + history; membership issued (AZR-MEM-*), public /membership/verify with token returns valid=true with masked name + member_since; QR PNG served; CMS visuals GET/PUT idempotent; settings PUT accepts whatsapp payload; analytics overview returns dict. Response envelope {success,data,meta.request_id} confirmed. No 5xx across all tested endpoints. Console errors during authed flows: 0.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin routes use English slugs in App.tsx (/admin/certificates, /admin/customers, /admin/gemstones, /admin/jewelry, /admin/warranties, /admin/ownership, /admin/membership) while sidebar labels + i18n copy use Indonesian ('Sertifikat', 'Pelanggan', 'Batu Mulia' etc.). This is intentional (URL is a separate concern from labels) and works; noting for future maintainers who might assume routes are Indonesian.

verify.py per-IP rate limiter is in-memory per-process (60s / 20 attempts). Fine for single-worker preview but does NOT survive multi-worker or restart — acceptable for MVP; worth noting for production hardening.

certificates.py issue endpoint returns 'certificate_uuid' (not 'uuid') at the top level of the response payload — inconsistent with the rest of the API that uses 'uuid'. Not a bug, but a minor API-shape inconsistency that could confuse downstream consumers.

Ownership.assign endpoint (POST /api/admin/ownership/assign) is decorated status_code=201 but the underlying service returns the current-state response — verified 201 in practice; consider returning a discriminated response model for clarity.

Pre-existing baseline drift from iteration_21 still present: /api/settings/public shows dashboard_bg_enabled and login_bg_enabled = true with /api/media/* URLs (spec requires defaults). Not touched by this iteration; flagged for main-agent decision.
